svg.title: The even construction at height six
svg.desc: Top: the row R and its reflection c-R on the 66-site cycle with their eleven gaps. Below, the 66 sites are drawn in three layers of 22, so each column is one residue class modulo 22. Blue cells belong to the rows R+22j and clay cells to the reflected rows c-R+22j with c=13; the digit in a cell is j. Each column is filled by the three translates of a single row. Below, the residues of R and of its reflection partition the 22 classes.

g.text: digit in a cell: the translate j
